title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON MANAGEMENT OF FIREFIGHTING EQUIPMENT
full_text:
⊙ Presidential Decree No. 36432 (June 23, 2026)

Presidential Decree on Partial Amendments to 21 Statutes under the Jurisdiction of the National Fire Agency Following the Establishment of Integrated Special Cities

Articles 1 through 14 Omitted

Article 15 (Amendment to the Enforcement Decree of the Act on Management of Firefighting Equipment) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Management of Firefighting Equipment is partially amended as follows.
In Article 3 (3), “Metropolitan City Mayor” is replaced with “Integrated Special City Mayor or Metropolitan City Mayor”.

Articles 16 through 21 Omitted

Addenda

This Decree shall enter into force on July 1, 2026.

[Batch Amendment]

◇ Reasons for Amendment and Main Provisions

The Special Act on the Establishment of Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City has been enacted (Act No. 21446, promulgated on March 5, 2026, effective July 1, 2026), providing, among other matters, for the abolition of the former Jeollanam-do and Gwangju Metropolitan City, the establishment of Jeonnam-Gwangju Integrated Special City, and two deputy heads at the integrated special city's fire headquarters. Accordingly, integrated special cities and their mayors are reflected in provisions concerning local governments and their heads in Presidential Decrees under the jurisdiction of the National Fire Agency, including by adding integrated special cities to the areas covered by City/Do 119 rescue and emergency medical service implementation plans. The President will exercise the authority to appoint the newly established deputy heads of an integrated special city's fire headquarters, rather than delegating that authority to the Integrated Special City Mayor. These changes amend 21 Presidential Decrees under the jurisdiction of the National Fire Agency, including the Enforcement Decree of the Act on 119 Rescue and Emergency Medical Services.

<Provided by the Ministry of Government Legislation>
